GPTGTA Version Archive

Playable preserved lineage from the first GPT-built browser prototype through the current v5.4.19.2 Metro City build with garage systems, car customizer, metro platform polish, interiors, elevated transit, moving traffic and the broader v5.4.x city layer.

To the best of my knowledge, GPTGTA is one of the first public GPT-native top-down GTA-style browser sandboxes with a preserved playable version lineage.
CURRENT BUILD · v5.4.19.2
GPTGTA Metro City

The latest public build moves the archive beyond the older v4.2.31 chaos branch into the current Metro City era: cleaner roads, denser city rhythm, garage/customizer flow, metro platform fixes, interiors, parking lots, rooftops, beach/canal areas and more stable traffic presentation.

v4.2.31 remains preserved below as the iconic fast-cars / ARSONIST branch, but it is no longer the current public build.

Play latest v5.4.19.2 Version archive entry

Intermediate dev builds from v4.3 through v5.4.6 are folded into the current v5.4.19.2 lineage and are intentionally not shown as separate archive cards here, because they do not have finished public preview tiles.
